infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow Smart Shopper to convert your speech into shopping items.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Smart Shopper to access your microphone for voice commands.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Smart Shopper to take profile photos.
